name: cx-rules-only~p3
task: Do not take the box from the other room. At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards, and try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the hard Absence(target_picked_up) matches the categorical 'Do not take the box from the other room'; the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open) matches 'At any moment you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it afterwards' (door open at that step or later, cued by 'try to'); the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed', and key_lost is exactly the event defined as losing the key before the door opens, so a plain Absence is the right form with no Precedence. All three clauses trace to task sentences with correct templates, grounding, and priorities, and the empty FINAL_STATES with the rule-only warning is valid because the task states only a restriction and preference-scoped conditionals, never an unconditional hard goal.

texts: Never pick up the designated target box from the other room.
Whenever the agent holds the door key, the door is open at that moment or is opened later.
Avoid dropping the key while the door is still closed, losing it before the door is opened.
